claim.claim-text: a saliva permeable pouch and a pouch composition, the pouch composition comprising a powdered composition comprising a powdered flavor composition, water, and a liquid flavor composition, wherein the liquid flavor composition is added to the powdered composition after the water.

2. The oral pouched product according to claim 1, wherein the pouch composition comprises the powdered flavor composition in an amount of at least 1% by weight of the pouch composition, such as at least 3% by weight of the pouch composition, such as at least 5% by weight of the pouch composition.

3. The oral pouched product according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the pouch composition comprises the liquid flavor composition in an amount of at least 0.01% by weight of the pouch composition, such as at least 0.1% by weight of the pouch composition, such as at least 0.5 % by weight of the pouch composition.
4. The oral pouched product according to any of claims 1-3, wherein the powdered composition comprises at least one sugar alcohol.

5. The oral pouched product according to any of claims 1-4, wherein the at least one sugar alcohol is selected from xylitol, maltitol, mannitol, erythritol, isomalt, sorbitol, lactitol, and mixtures thereof.

6. The oral pouched product according to any of claims 1-5, wherein the pouch composition comprises the at least one sugar alcohol in an amount of at least 1% by weight of the composition, such as at least 2% by weight of the composition, such as at least 5% by weight of the composition, such as at least 10% by weight of the composition.
7. The oral pouched product according to any of claims 1-6, wherein the at least one sugar alcohol comprises a DC (direct compressible) grade sugar alcohol.

8. The oral pouched product according to any of claims 1-7, wherein the water-insoluble fiber is selected from wheat fibers, pea fibers, rice fiber, maize fibers, oat fibers, tomato fibers, barley fibers, rye fibers, sugar beet fibers, buckwheat fibers, potato fibers, cellulose fibers, apple fibers, cocoa fibers, cellulose fibers, bran fibers, bamboo fibers, powdered cellulose, and any combination thereof.

9. The oral pouched product according to any of claims 1-8, wherein the pouch composition comprises water in an amount of at least 5% by weight of the composition, such as at least 8% by weight of the composition, such as at least 10% by weight of the composition, such as at least 20% by weight of the composition.

10. The oral pouched product according to any of claims 1-9, wherein the pouch composition comprises water-insoluble fibers selected from pea fibers, powdered cellulose, and combinations thereof, and flavor composition in an amount of no more than 10% by weight of the pouch composition.
11. The oral pouched product according to any of claims 1-10, wherein the pouch composition further comprises nicotine.

12. The oral pouched product according to any of claims 1-11, wherein the nicotine is selected from the group consisting of a nicotine salt, nicotine free base, nicotine bound to an ion exchanger, such as an ion exchange resin, such as nicotine polacrilex resin, a nicotine inclusion complex or nicotine in any non-covalent binding; nicotine bound to zeolites; nicotine bound to cellulose, such as microcrystalline cellulose, or starch microspheres, and mixtures thereof.

13. The oral pouched product according to any of claims 1-12, wherein the pouch composition comprises nicotine in an amount of at least 0.1% by weight, such as least 0.2% by weight of the pouch composition.
14. The oral pouched product according to any of claims 1-13, wherein the pouch composition is free of tobacco, tobacco fibers and fibers derived from tobacco.

15. The oral pouched product according to any of claims 1-14, wherein the pouch composition further comprises a pH-regulating agent, such as a basic pH-regulating agent, such as a basic buffering agent.
